passive.name: Damnation
passive.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

spells.name: Death Sentence
spells.description: Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for seconds. The scythe does magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration. Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy. If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by seconds.

spells.name: Dark Passage
spells.description: Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh. The lantern also grants Shield for seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.
spells.coverageNote: This cast changes combat state, but no complete state module is registered yet.
